summary.text: Mike Schatz is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from District 39 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Schatz graduated from New England High School and earned a B.S. from Minot State University in 1976, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes working as a farmer and rancher, a teacher and a coach, and he served as vice president of the Education Standards & Practices Board and president of the New England Park Board.
Ballotpedia lists a prior term in the North Dakota House of Representatives from 1988 to 1990.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Appropriations - Education and Environment Committee.
